summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Orla Mining Ltd., a foreign private issuer, which includes a press release dated May 4, 2026, describing actions taken to protect labour rights at its Camino Rojo gold mine in Mexico following a CUSMA Panel determination. The filing details operational and governance measures such as appointing a Director of Risk Compliance and a new General Manager, implementing a Labour Rights Policy, and enhancing security. It does not involve any M&A, restructuring, activism, or other special-situation corporate event. The filing is a routine operational update under the 1934 Act.
